summary.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action
summary.description: Kaufman skill map untuk menguasai SQL secara efektif, dengan target skill produksi, operating model SQL, feedback loop, deliberate practice, dan mental model engineer-level.

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 001
parts.description: Kaufman skill map untuk menguasai SQL secara efektif, dengan target skill produksi, operating model SQL, feedback loop, deliberate practice, dan mental model engineer-level.
parts.partTitle: Kaufman Skill Map and SQL Operating Model
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 002
parts.description: Fondasi relational model untuk SQL production: relation, tuple, attribute, domain, predicate, key, set vs bag, NULL, three-valued logic, dan relational reasoning.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 003
parts.description: Mental model database engine untuk memahami perjalanan SQL dari text menjadi result: parser, binder, rewriter, optimizer, executor, storage engine, buffer pool, WAL, lock manager, MVCC, dan catalog.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 004
parts.description: SQL syntax sebagai intent deklaratif: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT/FETCH, logical processing order, alias scope, expression evaluation, dan bug semantic umum.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 005
parts.description: Schema design as invariant engineering: tables, keys, constraints, defaults, identity, generated columns, referential integrity, naming, and production review discipline.
parts.partTitle: Schema Design: Tables, Keys, and Constraints
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 006
parts.description: Data types as domain contracts: numeric precision, temporal correctness, text/collation, boolean modelling, UUIDs, enums, domains, binary data, coercion, and production failure modes.
parts.partTitle: Data Types, Domains, and Precision Failure
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 007
parts.description: Semantik INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, dan MERGE untuk sistem produksi: mutasi data, upsert, returning/output, write amplification, idempotency, optimistic update, lost update prevention, dan desain DML yang aman.
parts.partTitle: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and MERGE Semantics
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 008
parts.description: Filtering, predicates, three-valued logic, NULL traps, IN/EXISTS, BETWEEN, LIKE, regex, sargability, implicit cast, dan desain predicate yang benar untuk sistem produksi.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 009
parts.description: Join sebagai mekanisme menggabungkan fakta dan relationship secara benar, termasuk inner join, outer join, semi join, anti join, fan-out, null-extension, dan debugging cardinality.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 010
parts.description: Aggregation, grouping, dan measure correctness untuk SQL produksi, termasuk COUNT variants, SUM/AVG, GROUP BY, HAVING, distinct aggregation, conditional aggregation, rollup, cube, grouping sets, dan metric traps.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 011
parts.description: Subqueries, CTEs, and query composition for production SQL: scalar/table subqueries, correlated queries, derived tables, recursive CTEs, LATERAL/APPLY, materialization behavior, and composable query contracts.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 012
parts.description: Production-grade window functions: partitioning, ordering, frames, ranking, running totals, latest-row selection, gaps-and-islands, sessionization, deduplication, audit timelines, and performance reasoning.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 013
parts.description: Production-grade set operations and relational differencing: UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, ALL vs DISTINCT, reconciliation, delta detection, data comparison, audit validation, and correctness traps.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 014
parts.description: First-principles index literacy: B-tree, hash, bitmap, BRIN/zonemap, covering indexes, composite order, selectivity, clustering, write cost, and production index trade-offs.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 015
parts.description: Practical index design through sargability, access paths, predicate shape, composite index order, covering indexes, partial indexes, expression indexes, and production workload reasoning.
parts.partTitle: Sargability, Access Paths, and Index Design
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 016
parts.description: Query plan literacy for production SQL: EXPLAIN, actual plans, scans, joins, sorts, aggregates, cost estimates, cardinality, plan debugging, and optimizer reasoning.
parts.partTitle: Query Plans, EXPLAIN, and Optimizer Literacy
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 017
parts.description: Cardinality, statistics, and cost model failures for production SQL: row estimates, histograms, skew, correlation, parameter-sensitive plans, stale stats, and practical remediation.
parts.partTitle: Cardinality, Statistics, and Cost Model Failures
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 018
parts.description: Transactions, ACID, and unit-of-work design for production SQL: transaction boundaries, commit/rollback, savepoints, idempotency, retries, invariants, and application/database consistency.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 019
parts.description: Isolation levels, MVCC, locks, and concurrency anomalies for production SQL: visibility rules, lost updates, write skew, phantoms, serializability, and anomaly testing.
parts.partTitle: Isolation Levels, MVCC, Locking, and Anomalies
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 020
parts.description: Concurrency control, deadlocks, and contention in production SQL: lock waits, hot rows, queue patterns, SKIP LOCKED, advisory locks, retry loops, and throughput/correctness trade-offs.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 021
parts.description: Normalization, denormalization, dependency theory, data shape, aggregate boundaries, read/write model trade-offs, and schema evolution cost for production relational systems.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 022
parts.description: Modelling real business workflows in SQL: state machines, lifecycle tables, audit trails, approvals, escalation, temporal facts, events, and defensible case management data models.
parts.partTitle: Modelling Real Business Workflows in SQL
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 023
parts.description: Temporal SQL, history, and auditability: valid time, transaction time, bitemporal modelling, immutable history, audit trails, point-in-time reconstruction, and defensible data lineage.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 024
parts.description: JSON, semi-structured data, and hybrid relational design: when to use JSON, how to index it, how to validate it, how to migrate out of blobs, and how to keep relational truth governable.
parts.partTitle: JSON, Semi-Structured, and Hybrid Relational Design
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 025
parts.description: Partitioning, sharding, and large table strategy: how to divide large relational data safely without confusing physical layout with logical modelling.
parts.partTitle: Partitioning, Sharding, and Large Table Strategy
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 026
parts.description: Views, materialized views, and derived truth: how to use query abstractions, persisted results, refresh strategies, and dependency boundaries without corrupting source-of-truth semantics.
parts.partTitle: Views, Materialized Views, and Derived Truth
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 027
parts.description: Stored procedures, functions, triggers, and database boundary design: when executable database logic protects invariants, when it damages operability, and how to design it deliberately.
parts.partTitle: Stored Procedures, Functions, and Database Boundaries
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 028
parts.description: Migrations, schema evolution, and backward compatibility: how to safely change relational databases under live traffic using expand-contract, backfills, validation, and release choreography.
parts.partTitle: Migrations, Schema Evolution, and Backward Compatibility
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 029
parts.description: Security, permissions, and data access control in SQL systems: roles, privileges, row-level security, column protection, tenant isolation, SQL injection prevention, auditability, and least-privilege review.
parts.partTitle: Security, Permissions, and Data Access Control
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 030
parts.description: Analytics SQL for engineering decisions: metric correctness, funnels, cohorts, retention, SLA/SLO analysis, latency percentiles, incident analysis, anomaly detection, and decision-grade query design.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 031
parts.description: Data quality, testing, and SQL as an assertion language for production systems: invariant queries, reconciliation, duplicate detection, referential drift, data contract tests, freshness, sampling, and release gates.
parts.partTitle: Data Quality, Testing, and SQL as Assertion Language
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 032
parts.description: Observability, performance, and operational debugging for SQL systems: slow queries, wait events, locks, buffer/cache metrics, index bloat, vacuum/analyze, query regression, and production playbooks.
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 033
parts.description: SQL portability across engines, dialect differences, conformance gaps, type-system traps, isolation differences, JSON/date/time behavior, optimizer differences, and a production portability strategy.
parts.partTitle: SQL Across Engines: Portability and Vendor Differences
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 034
parts.description: System design with SQL and relational databases: OLTP vs OLAP, read replicas, CQRS, outbox/inbox, CDC, transactional messaging, cache invalidation, consistency boundaries, and failure modelling.
parts.partTitle: System Design with SQL and Relational Databases
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action

parts.title: Learn SQL in Action - Part 035
parts.description: Capstone production casebook untuk menggabungkan relational modelling, query correctness, optimizer literacy, transactions, concurrency, security, migration, analytics, observability, dan failure modelling dalam satu sistem case management.
parts.partTitle: Capstone: SQL in Action Production Casebook
parts.seriesTitle: Learn SQL in Action
